title: B2-15 · Translation to Arabic: simple texts

blocks.text: B2-15 · Translation to Arabic: simple texts

Translating to Arabic is more difficult than translating from Arabic: the Italian "tire" the Arabic phrase towards its structures, and the result is an Arabic understandable but full of casts: the article in the wrong place, the Italian preposition translated to the letter, the order of the Italian words, the wrong agreements with the plural of things. At level B2 The goal is realistic: to translate simple and short texts (warnings, formal messages, short news) into a correct and clear Arabic, using as a model the Arabic texts you know. In this unit learn the basic rules of translation to Arabic (G73), the prepositions that change from one language to another, the most frequent casts and the method of parallel texts. Four weeks, in parallel with the end of EGY-17 and the beginning of EGY-18.

rows: B2-13, B2-14; B1-22 (the formal letter); B1-08 (order and agreement)
20–22 hours · four weeks (weeks 216–219), plus the EGY track in separate blocks

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Reference Grammar (G)73), an Italian-Arabic dictionary, Arabic texts from previous units such as models, sessions with the tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. build correctly in Arabic iḍāfa, agreements (including with pluralities of things), numbers and relative;
2. Choose the order of Arabic words and connections suitable for a journalistic or administrative text;
3. use the right Arab prepositions with the most frequent verbs, without limestone the Italian;
4. recognizing and correcting the most common casts from English;
5. to translate a formal notice, message and short news of 80–120 words, using text parallel. Four-week plan.

blocks.text: The names of institutions are often feminine. ⁧وِزَارَة⁩ , ⁧بَلَدِيَّة⁩ , ⁧حُكُومَة⁩ , ⁧شَرِكَة⁩ , ⁧جَامِعَة⁩ , ⁧لَجْنَة⁩ , ⁧نِقَابَة⁩ : verbs and adjectives to female ( ⁧أَعْلَنَتِ الشَّرِكَةُ⁩ … · ⁧الجَامِعَةُ الجَدِيدَةُ⁩ ).

Numbers (review) B1-13). 3–10: the number has the genus opposite to the name and the name goes to the plural genitive ( ⁧ثَلَاثَةُ كُتُبٍ⁩ · ⁧ثَلَاثُ مَدَارِسَ⁩ ). 11–99: name to the accusatory singular ( ⁧خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ طَالِبًا⁩ · ⁧عِشْرُونَ مَدْرَسَةً⁩ ). 100, 1000, million: name to the singular parent ( ⁧مِئَةُ طَالِبٍ⁩ · ⁧أَلْفُ يُورُو⁩ ). In the news the figures are almost always written in numbers: ⁧٣٠ مَدْرَسَةً⁩ , but the name rule remains. The percentages and figures follow the prepositions of B2-04: ⁧بِنِسْبَةِ⁩ (change), ⁧إِلَى⁩ (final value), ⁧بِمِقْدَارِ⁩ (of how much). Related.

blocks.text: The method of parallel texts. Before translating a type of text, read three or four original Arabic texts of the same type (warnings, announcements, short news) and note: opening and closing formulas, typical verbs, structure. Then translate using those formulas. It is the safest way to avoid casts: instead of translating Italian, ...reconstruct an Arabic text of the same genre with information from the Italian text.
